description: Implementation of scalar pointwise operators for a fuzzing framework, including classes for scalar operations like add, subtract, multiply, and divide, with code generation and input specification methods.

classes.name: ScalarPointwiseOperator
classes.description: Base class for scalar pointwise operations, providing methods for code generation, input specification, and operation properties.

classes.name: ScalarDivOperator
classes.description: Operator class for scalar division, with special codegen to handle zero denominators.

methods.name: torch_op_name
methods.description: Returns None, indicating no specific torch operation for scalar operators.

methods.name: can_produce
methods.description: Checks if the output spec is a scalar and not boolean.

methods.name: fuzz_inputs_specs
methods.description: Generates input specs for scalar operations with type promotion.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates code for scalar pointwise operations, with special handling for division to prevent zero division errors.
